cards.title: Why it was never drawn
items: A mask draws an element's whole subtree through itself, a position: fixed child included, and hides what reaches past its box
A row's card opens to the right of the rail, over the stage, so since 0.9.0 it was in the page at full opacity and never painted

cards.title: Checked
items: The test failed first: the label was a descendant of the clipped container. It passes with the label on the shell's root, in a dialog, and on the body when there is no shell
Seen in the running interface, before and after, captured through a fresh raster: the card is drawn, in the rail's typeface, and an ordinary tip still opens in place
